d: Donald Trump’s Republican Party has suffered a major setback in the US midterm elections, with Democrats taking control of both the House of Representatives and the Senate, according to the results described in this report. But Trump has refused to blame himself. He claimed that Republicans would have won by a huge margin if he had been on the ballot. He also congratulated the Democrats and blamed some Republican candidates for failing to attract voters. What exactly did Trump say after the defeat, and what could the Democratic majority mean for the remaining two years of his presidency?
